snippet.title: Enhanced Animal Diversity || Devlog #01
snippet.description:
Dear Heroes of the Island,

We are excited to share new updates that will further enrich your strategy and economic simulation experience! As you build your trading empire, let’s explore together how the dynamic elements in our game have evolved.

Expanded Weather Dynamics
To the existing eight weather conditions in our game, we have now added 5 new weather types: sandstorm, snowstorm, thunderstorm, heavy rain, and foggy weather. These additions directly influence plant and product pricing as well as NPC behaviors, allowing you to reshape your trading strategies. With each weather condition presenting unique challenges and opportunities, you’re invited to plan your trade moves even more strategically!

Enhanced Animal Variety and Products
To create a more vibrant and diverse environment, we’ve introduced new animal types into your inventory. Now, thanks to the addition of chickens, sheep, and other charming farm residents, you’ll encounter fresh opportunities to produce valuable items such as:

Eggs

Chicken Meat

Wool

Sheep Meat

These products will enable you to invigorate your market and boost your earnings with innovative strategies!

Your Strategy, Your Story
Discover how the new weather conditions and expanded animal variety impact the game’s flow. With timely strategic decisions, make your market stand out and step by step become the most successful merchant in town.

Improving Together with Your Feedback
Although the game is not yet released, you are welcome to review this announcement and share your feedback, requests, and ideas with us. Your insights are invaluable as we shape a more immersive and realistic experience!

Happy gaming,
The Island Market Simulator Team
